items.excerpt: A developer used Anthropic's Claude to build a complete RTX-accelerated path tracer in about an hour, with the AI handling system-level graphics engineering from scratch. Wccftech frames it as a sign of autonomous AI coding reaching real-time rendering tools.
items.title: Claude AI Helped Make an RTX-Accelerated Path Tracer From Start to Finish in Just an Hour

items.excerpt: OpenDLSS-NR reimplements DLSS 5's neural rendering in Vulkan, hitting 7.8 ms at 1080p on an RTX 4070 and even running in browsers. It opens the AI 're-lighting' filter to hardware and developers outside NVIDIA's official stack.
items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Gets Open-Source Vulkan Reimplementation, Runs on RTX 40 GPUs and Even in Web Browsers

items.excerpt: PC Gamer forced DLSS 5's neural rendering onto a stylized Hatsune Miku rhythm game, showing how the AI model drags anime art direction toward photoreal faces and lighting. A hands-on look at where the generative filter clashes with non-realistic styles.
items.title: Behold the DLSS 5 horrors I have unleashed

items.excerpt: Steam's week-long Punk Games Showcase starts October 9 with 100+ curated games out of 400 submissions, explicitly filtering out titles that used generative AI. Curation by 'no genAI' is becoming a storefront feature in its own right.
items.title: Steam's Punk Games Showcase Hates AI Slop, Loves Blowing Up Nazis

items.excerpt: RGG Studio says it recreated the late Tupac Shakur as a character in Stranger Than Heaven using traditional research and performance methods, confirming no AI technology was used. A notable stance on digital likeness of deceased artists in games.
items.title: Stranger Than Heaven Studio Made The Tupac Resurrection Less Weird By Not Using AI

items.excerpt: Remedy's Control Resonant, confirmed as made without AI, includes a collectible, 'The Great Copy Battle', a deliberately awful movie script that lampoons generative-AI slop. It joins a wave of games using in-world writing to take a stance on AI-made content.
items.title: Control Resonant Is The Latest Game To Mock GenAI

items.excerpt: LOVE alt delete is an upcoming psychological-horror visual novel where you beta-test 'MUSE' romance chatbots, typing freely and roping in a second chatbot to help court the first, all without using generative AI itself. AI companionship as theme and interface, hand-authored as craft.
items.title: LOVE alt delete is a Y2K horror visual novel where you use one AI chatbot to help you date another

items.excerpt: 카카오게임즈가 10월 8일 출시하는 2.5D MMORPG '도깨비의세계'에 플레이 데이터를 분석해 성장 방향을 안내하는 AI 챗봇 '묘롱'을 도입해 초심자 진입장벽을 낮췄다. AI 가이드를 온보딩 UX로 활용한 국내 사례.
items.title: 도깨비의세계, 12가지 스킬로 진입장벽 낮춘다

items.excerpt: At Oz Comic-Con Brisbane, a stallholder accused by a fellow artist of selling AI-generated imagery allegedly bit an attendee during the confrontation; all parties were banned. Aftermath uses it to frame the escalating human-artist vs AI-art conflict in convention artist alleys.
items.title: 'Man Banned From Oz Comic-Con After Biting Incident' Is Not An AI-Related Headline I Thought I'd Be Reading

items.excerpt: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3.8 Live adds Live Avatar, giving the conversational model a near real-time animated visual presence. Real-time talking avatars are a building block for AI-driven characters and companions.
items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
